name: managing-chemotherapy-protocols
description: Verifies chemotherapy and other antineoplastic orders against the regimen, order set version and product labels, and reviews protocol adherence and safety documentation for pharmacists, oncology nurses and quality reviewers. Recomputes BSA from verified height and weight (Mosteller or the order set's formula), flags stale or estimated weights and BSA capped at 2.0 m² without a documented reason (ASCO obesity dosing guideline), checks carboplatin Calvert dosing and the 125 mL/min GFR cap, builds lifetime anthracycline cumulative-dose ledgers that include outside facilities and earlier lines, confirms cycle day, interval and lab hold parameters, and audits the ASCO-ONS four verifications, oral chemotherapy orders, vincristine and vinca alkaloid minibag and intrathecal safety (ISMP), and USP <800> handling. Use for chemo order verification, double check, dose calculation check, cumulative dose, protocol deviation review or chemotherapy safety audit. Drafts for clinician review; never writes or changes orders.
